name: overview-widget-dashboard
title: Overview v2 widget dashboard — customizable grid & Lucius integration
body: Verify the Overview tab's redesigned widget dashboard with customizable grid, Lucius integration, and widget interactions. This tests the root-cause overlap bug fix and all 6 areas of parity restoration.

criteria.text: Widget overlap bug is fixed: No widget visually overlaps or paints over another, especially Daily Briefing versus widgets below it. Confirm no text/content bleeding.
Customize mode: Opens without errors; 12-column dashed grid overlay appears while dragging; grid renders properly (not hidden).
Customize drag: Dragging a widget's handle shows live reflow (other widgets move) and on release, layout compacts correctly.
Resize handles: Resize from multiple corners/edges works correctly; widget resizes in the correct direction.
Fullscreen widget view: Clicking a widget opens a split view with the widget content and an Appearance/Data settings rail. Settings changes apply live.
Add widget picker: Opens as a flat searchable list (not sectioned by group initially); picking a widget adds it to the dashboard with a visible highlight/scroll-into-view.
Build with Lucius: Picking 'Generate as custom' from the picker actually adds a widget instance to the dashboard (previously dead/no-op). No errors.
Needs Attention widget: Each risk row has a dismiss (✕) button; dismissed risks are removed from view. If more risks than limit, '+N more' message appears.
Today's movers widget: Respects row-limit setting and shows '+N more' line if truncated.
Customize Cancel: After making edits (add/drag/resize), clicking Cancel reverts the view exactly to its pre-Customize state.
Unified widget model: Every card (predefined and Lucius-generated) renders with the same card chrome (title row, kebab menu, drag handle). No special treatment.
General regression: No console errors, garbled numbers, or obviously broken layouts. Overview, Reports, and any other sub-views load correctly.
Container-driven reflow automatically grows a widget and repacks every widget below it with the normal grid gap; shrinking back remains stable and saved fixed heights continue to act as a floor.

Net Worth keeps Today, Unrealized P&L, Cash on hand, and Liabilities visible at all supported card widths: four columns when wide, a complete 2×2 grid when compact, and a readable single column when very narrow.
Cash Flow keeps In/Out labels, bars, amounts, and transaction counts visible when its card is resized; compact cards move each bar below its label and amount without clipping.
